title: Wednesday assorted links
contentHtml:
1. Chinese AI companies way down in value.

2. Allison Schrager is starting a podcast with Ken Rogoff.

3. Extensive survey of students on AI.

4. Robert Lynch on lookism.

5. New version of Claude Blattman.

6. Seb Krier on the Christiano interview.  The whole dialogue over this interview is a good example of why we have needed (and not really received) a peer-reviewed tier to the discourse on these aspects of AI safety.  A more rigorous argument really needed to be forced here.

7. Poland foiled a Kaliningrad operation?
